battlecards.why_selected: Lowest evaluated cost after GPO pricing, committed to hold all non-pharma pricing firm for 12 months and match HPG tier-3 rebate structure; offered dedicated implementation team to consolidate all locations.
battlecards.contract_terms: 2-year distributor agreement executed 30-Jul-2021 with 12-month price hold (non-pharma) + mutual option to renew for 1 year; HPG contract #MS00231 referenced; quarterly rebate true-up.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Multi-supplier RFP with historical purchase usage provided, willingness to transition supplier, PE-backed volume growth narrative, dual-GPO benchmarks.
supplier_weaknesses: Less flexible on specialty pharma pricing outside GPO
battlecards.switching_costs: Staff training on McKesson SupplyManager portal, formulary cross-reference of ~1,200 SKUs, new account setups for 30+ ship-to locations.
battlecards.notes: Pricing discrepancy escalation process agreed—McKesson to audit first 90-days invoices against awarded file.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Could not meet McKesson/HPG pricing targets and declined to match 12-month price lock requirement.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of full distributor switch and consolidated volume.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher net pricing even after extended terms
battlecards.switching_costs: Low—systems already compatible with other distributors; staff familiarity only minor factor.
battlecards.notes: Will remain secondary for back-order fills until cut-over complete (90-day tail).

battlecards.why_selected: Best value on west-and-central MA & NH route clusters; agreed to implement barcode chain-of-custody and absorb fuel surcharge risk for term.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year Master Transportation Agreement (Aug-2021) with CPI cap 3%/yr; Service-level credits for >2% late deliveries/qtr.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Aggregated volume from 33 locations and ability to split award; detailed lane-level cost model shared with bidders.
supplier_weaknesses: Smaller fleet—capacity constraints during winter peaks
battlecards.switching_costs: Route re-mapping, new pick-up schedules communicated to clinics.
battlecards.notes: Handles ~60% of scheduled routes; Xpressman covers remaining metro-Boston lanes.

battlecards.why_selected: Strong coverage for greater-Boston STAT work, offered 90-minute on-demand SLA at no premium and WBENC diversity status.
battlecards.contract_terms: 2-year contract (Sep-2021) with option year; fuel surcharge pegged to DOE index with 5% ceiling.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Competition with Millers on metro zones and willingness to accept secondary volume.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher base rate on long-haul lanes
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal—same manifest template used as incumbent.
battlecards.notes: Transition completed within 30 days; no service interruption.

battlecards.why_selected: Agreed to drop blended hourly rate to $26.60 and implement 10% hour reduction within 3 months while covering all 33 sites.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year MSA effective 1-Jun-2022; retro-pricing back to 6-Jun-2022; growth incentive—first month free for new sites.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Alves’ lower BAFO created credible switch threat; detailed site hours & SLA scorecard shared.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher rate than Alves, need to prove efficiency savings
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-badging staff, background checks, cleaning supplies change.
battlecards.notes: Treya monitoring monthly hours to enforce 10% reduction target.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Offered highest savings ($312K) but unable to cover 6 rural locations and concerns about transition capacity.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as pricing pressure on incumbent.

battlecards.why_selected: Bundled 37 circuits under single invoice, offered 30-month term with no early termination for clinic relocations.
battlecards.contract_terms: 30-month service order signed Aug-2021; flat MRC with auto renew month-to-month; OneSource manages MACD tickets.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to migrate to SD-WAN aggregator; Comcast contract expirations within 90 days.
supplier_weaknesses: Relies on underlying telcos for last-mile repair
battlecards.switching_costs: Truck rolls for circuit cut-over, potential downtime windows.
battlecards.notes: OneSource paid via 15% commission embedded—transparent during review.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Unable to meet OneSource aggregated price point and declined to waive ETF for circuit moves.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of full migration to aggregator.
supplier_weaknesses: Retail pricing, separate invoices per site
battlecards.switching_costs: Equipment return and service disconnect notices.

battlecards.why_selected: Matched lowest competitive take-over cost, provided 3-year rate lock at 1.50% collections and carved out cosmetic revenue.
battlecards.contract_terms: Addendum signed Feb-2022: 3-year term; quarterly look-back to adjust tier; patient statement fee $0.41.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Full RFP with demos; projected revenue growth to $250M; threat to switch platforms.
supplier_weaknesses: Limited customization, ancillary fees for statements
battlecards.switching_costs: Provider retraining, data migration, EDI interfaces—high.

battlecards.why_selected: Provided fixed discount off OEM list (10% Dell, 12% Lenovo) and imaging services at no charge; flexible hold-and-ship model for new acquisitions.
battlecards.contract_terms: MOU dated Sep-2021, 24-month term with quarterly catalog refresh; Net-30 terms.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Historical spend analysis showed fragmented buying; commitment to single reseller channeled ~400K future spend.
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal—device images provided by APDerm IT; no leasing lock-in.

battlecards.why_selected: Treya GPO programme delivered higher discounts across Ground and Air plus 166 DIM factor and waived residential surcharge for clinics.
battlecards.contract_terms: UPS Member Agreement executed Jun-2021, 3-year term; grace period for performance review at 12 months.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Benchmark analysis of 2020 FedEx invoices and threat to move full volume.
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-labeling software, account number updates in EMR shipping plug-in.

battlecards.why_selected: Agreed to refresh 200-item core list at 8% reduction and institute 1% annual growth rebate.
battlecards.contract_terms: 24-month pricing addendum dated May-2021; rebate paid annually if spend >$150K.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Price benchmarking deck presented showing +11% variance to OD market basket.
battlecards.switching_costs: Low but would require new login credentials and credit apps for staff.

battlecards.why_selected: Premier GPO markup 62% vs 82% incumbent, national footprint to support growth.
battlecards.contract_terms: GPO rider executed Apr-2022, evergreen with 30-day exit.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Spend consolidation threat; benchmark of national GPO rates.
battlecards.switching_costs: Onboarding new workers through Randstad compliance portal.
battlecards.notes: Savings extrapolated to total annual temp labor baseline $174,793 ≈ $19.5K/yr.
